enrichment.summary: The district is adding $71,000 to its contract with Restoration Management Company, raising the limit from $99,000 to $170,000. The company continues environmental clean-up services to reduce risk at school sites. The term extends from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

enrichment.summary: The district would contract with George Hills Company, a third-party administrator, to handle liability and property claims, after rejecting all other bids. A data sharing agreement (DSA) with the same term covers the data the district sends and its protection.
